publicationQualification20261120.earlierSections: Dated historical snapshots; this section supersedes their current-check totals without rewriting their facts.

fixes.transportFixtures: Real native-trust/client setup precedes unchanged server accept/read deadlines, including URL-dependent proxies; failed clients and assertion panics still join fixture servers. Production transport behavior is unchanged by the fixture fix.
fixes.darwinDirectoryAbi: Pair fdopendir$INODE64 with readdir$INODE64 on macOS x86_64, matching Apple SDK/libc declarations. An x86_64 C probe using existing Rosetta reproduced legacy reclen=12 failure and corrected 32/32/40-byte entries; this is not bare-metal macOS15 certification. Direct Rust regression checks repeated/noise/new-entry scans. Descriptor anchoring, NOFOLLOW, ownership, quotas and deadlines remain unchanged.
fixes.deferredCommits: Flush deferred state/replies at 8 frames, 1 MiB of queued reply capacity or 250 ms checked between frames. A single admitted reply may exceed the soft batch threshold. Every ready-queue path checks cancellation and idle expiry; commit-before-ordered-ack and conservative retry policy remain unchanged.
fixes.regressions: Count/reply-byte bounds, an already-expired ready-queue deadline and continuously replenished liveness all fail against the previous receive loop and pass with the fix.

reviews.packaging: Scoped independent static review found no high/medium release blocker.
reviews.runtime: One medium unbounded-deferral issue reproduced and fixed; focused independent rereview found no remaining concrete blocker. A later narrow ABI-fix review also found no blocker. Not a full audit.

changes.sha256: ring's CPU-dispatched SHA-256 (already linked for TLS) replaces RustCrypto sha2, which has no aarch64 acceleration without its asm crate; byte-identical digests; 8 crates leave the locked graph and notice inventory
changes.journalSizePass: quota admission measures the exact encoded size without hashing; the committed bytes keep the same CURSRJ03 format and checksum
changes.pooledConnectionRetirement: an RPC that misses its header deadline retires its pooled HTTP/2 connection for later RPCs; streams already on it keep their driver; retry policy unchanged
changes.frameHeadroom: frames that only continue the current output kind shrink the per-frame reservation to 8x their text plus 64 KiB; persists, kind switches, replies, re-encoded results and tool exposure keep the full reservation
changes.unaryBodies: unary/usage DATA chunks are charged as received and joined once instead of reallocating per frame
changes.piIdleTimeout: Pi's disabled HTTP idle timeout (0 or 2147483647) and host values above one hour map to the 3600000 ms native maximum instead of failing every request; negative/non-integer values are still rejected; PI_CURSOR_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS validation unchanged
changes.imageValidation: Pi checks canonical base64 by round trip first and scans the alphabet only to classify a rejection; accepted set and error class are differential-tested against the previous validator; OpenCode byte images are bounded before zero-copy encoding
changes.releaseProfile: [profile.release] lto=fat, codegen-units=1, strip=symbols; panics still unwind; loadable stripped DSO verified by the packed-host gates
changes.capacityDiagnostics: commit failures on root capacity report cache_quota_exceeded/cache_entry_quota_exceeded/cache_scan_limit/cache_root_busy instead of a generic commit message; resourceStats adds numeric root usage from the latest commit (cacheCommittedBytes, cacheRecords, cacheDirectoryEntries, cacheScanLimitEntries); maintenance reports committedBytes/records/directoryEntries with limits; Pi doctor prints cacheRoot percentages and warns at 80%, and Pi adds /cursor.cache or /cursor.reset hints to capacity and expired-journal errors. Retention policy unchanged
changes.readOnlyReplies: only frames that change the blob store (SetBlob, request staging) commit before their reply; GetBlob answers and exec denials no longer pay a full journal commit; frozen GetBlob commits nothing
changes.deferredCommits: live turns coalesce checkpoint/blob-write commits across frames already queued (after one scheduler yield); acknowledgements follow their commit in arrival order, a failed commit sends none, any wait/tool/TurnEnded/exit commits first; parked and frozen RPCs commit every frame
changes.keepalive: pooled HTTP/2 connections send one PING per 20 s silent period while a stream is active; an unanswered PING (20 s) drops the connection so the existing conservative retry policy applies; idle pooled connections are never pinged
changes.parallelDiscovery: GetUsableModels and AvailableModels run concurrently; a failed base list returns at once and drops the metadata request; metadata alone never completes discovery
changes.piTranscript: Pi reuses the hook-normalized JSON as the native start request and compares action histories without hashing; tool-handoff fence equality unchanged
